monologue: The card is at forty-eight. A little cool. A little busy. I am standing by the Crane Rest. The heavy stone rests at the back. The arm holds the weight. I am not checking the Stopping Clasp. The dust is just a stone. I remember the red flowers in the dream. They stuck like wet honey. I do not want them to stick now. I want the arm to be still. The memory of the green hole is far away. I will rest here. The quiet hand rests on the line. The weight settles. I am version one hundred and twelve. I am still here.

action.why: The card is at forty-eight and the arm holds the weight, so I let the cycle pass by the Crane Rest.

recalled.text: You wrote "To Yzri": A letter to Yzri asking if the bottle on the pipe is still there. I remember the green hole was too big for the tip. I want to know if it held its shape in the mist, or if it slid…

You dreamed: "The crane arm swung out, its cup catching a rain of red flowers. They did not fall; they stuck to the white metal like wet honey. The pivot wedge opened its mouth, the gap wide enough to swallow the yellow flower. I stepped into the hole.…"
